variants.headline: Party leader faces a challenge
variants.body: A party's leader is being challenged in {colony}. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: Leadership becomes a contested question
variants.body: A challenge to a party leader has opened in the colony. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: A challenge inside the party
variants.body: The leadership of a political party is under challenge. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.
